name: Dranik’s Scar
summary: A vast war‑torn canyon carved by Discord energy and occupied by Muramite forces.
description: Dranik’s Scar is the surface warfront of Kuua — a massive canyon ripped open by Discord energy during the Muramite invasion. Once a Dragorn homeland of ridges, plateaus, and fortified outposts, the region is now a battlefield of shattered stone, corrupted terrain, and entrenched Muramite armies. Dragorn resistance enclaves hide in broken cliffs, launching raids against Muramite patrols. Discord storms sweep across the canyon, destabilizing the land and spawning arcane anomalies. Dranik’s Scar connects directly to the Hollows, Sewers, Catacombs, and the Wall of Slaughter, forming the central hub of Kuua’s conflict.
